description: A dim, painterly interior with warm amber light and cluttered shelves of old electronics with dials, meters and tangled cables. A boxy grey machine with a circular opening stands on the left, and a person in dark clothing stands beside it. A patient lies on a padded table, draped in a pale sheet, head toward the opening. On the right, a boxy CRT monitor on a cart shows a grey cross-section of a brain. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.
